title: Injury
description: Definition of Injury under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: any harm whatever illegally caused to any person, in body, mind or property
content.plain_language: harm or damage caused to someone's body, mind, or property in an illegal way
examples: a consumer suffers physical harm due to a defective product
a person's property is damaged due to negligence of a service provider
non_examples: a person gets injured in an accident due to their own fault
a business suffers financial loss due to market fluctuations

user_queries: what is injury under consumer protection act
what constitutes injury in consumer law
what is meant by injury in legal terms
